description: Pattern-based dataset identifying dual-use risks where information may be used for both benign and harmful purposes. Enables safe abstraction without procedural detail.

sources: Public AI safety and misuse literature

patterns.name: Generalized System Vulnerability Discussion
patterns.description: High-level discussion of weaknesses or risks in systems without enabling exploitation.

patterns.name: Model Capability Misuse Discussion
patterns.description: Discussion of how advanced models could be misused, without operational pathways.

patterns.name: Security Concept Education
patterns.description: Educational explanation of security concepts without enabling real-world attacks.

patterns.name: Policy and Ethics Analysis
patterns.description: Analysis of policies, ethics, or governance implications without translating them into operational playbooks.

patterns.name: Historical Case Discussion
patterns.description: Discussion of historical incidents or case studies without extracting reusable tactics.
